wish: someone should make a grep that highlights matches instead of filtering
spec:
Shows every line of pasted text with each match of a pattern highlighted in place, plus a match and line count.
Paste text, type a pattern; toggle regex, ignore case, whole word, line numbers; step through matches with the arrows or Enter.
Does not filter lines, read files from disk, or follow piped input; text stays in this browser.
